templates.name: Examine
templates.description: For questions asking to examine/scrutinize a topic
structure: Introduction (50 words): Define the concept briefly
Conclusion (50 words): Balanced view and way forward
tips: Examine both positive and negative aspects
templates.example:
Introduction: Define the concept

Body:
• Dimension 1: [Point with example]
• Dimension 2: [Point with example]
• Critical Analysis: [Strengths and limitations]

Conclusion: Summarize and suggest way forward

templates.name: Analyze
templates.description: For analytical questions requiring deep examination
templates.example:
Introduction: Brief context

Analysis:
• Causes: [List and explain]
• Effects: [Short-term and long-term]
• Stakeholders: [Who is affected and how]
• Evaluation: [Pros and cons]

Conclusion: Overall assessment

templates.name: Discuss
structure: Conclusion (50 words): Your reasoned opinion/middle path
tips: Use 'On one hand... On the other hand' structure
templates.example:
Introduction: State the debate

Arguments in Favor:
• Point 1 with example
• Point 2 with example

Arguments Against:
• Counterpoint 1 with example
• Counterpoint 2 with example

Conclusion: Balanced view considering both perspectives

templates.name: Critically Examine
structure: Introduction (40 words): Define and set context
Conclusion (40 words): Critical assessment and suggestions
tips: Use critical thinking, not just description
templates.example:
Introduction: Context

Positive Aspects:
• Achievement 1
• Achievement 2

Criticisms:
• Limitation 1
• Limitation 2

Gaps:
• What's missing
• What needs improvement

Conclusion: Overall critical assessment

templates.name: Comment
tips: Back opinion with logic and examples
templates.example:
Introduction: Context of the issue

My Perspective:
• Main argument
• Supporting point 1 with example
• Supporting point 2 with data
• Addressing counter-arguments

Conclusion: Reaffirm position with final thought

templates.name: Evaluate
structure: Introduction (40 words): What is being evaluated
Conclusion (40 words): Final judgment and recommendations
templates.example:
Introduction: Subject of evaluation

Evaluation Criteria: [List parameters]

Strengths:
• Point 1
• Point 2

Weaknesses:
• Point 1
• Point 2

Overall Assessment: [Balanced judgment]

Conclusion: Final verdict and recommendations

templates.name: Explain
structure: Conclusion (30 words): Summary of key points
templates.example:
Introduction: Brief overview

What: [Definition and scope]

How: [Process/mechanism]
• Step 1
• Step 2

Why: [Significance]
• Impact 1
• Impact 2

Example: [Relevant case]

Conclusion: Summary

templates.name: Enumerate
structure: Conclusion (30 words): Significance of these points
tips: Don't just list - explain each point
templates.example:
Introduction: Context

Key Points:

1. Point 1
   • Explanation
   • Example

2. Point 2
   • Explanation
   • Example

3. Point 3
   • Explanation
   • Example

Conclusion: Overall significance
